gloss: portrait rights; right to one's own image

definitions.gloss: portrait rights; right to one's own image
definitions.explanation: The right not to have one's face or figure photographed, published, or used commercially without consent. In Japan it is recognized by case law rather than by a single statute.

examples.japanese: {肖像権|しょうぞうけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be mindful of portrait rights.

examples.japanese: ⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{肖像権|しょうぞうけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{侵害|しんがい}→侵害：11563_shingai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Using a photograph without permission constitutes an infringement of portrait rights.

examples.english: Before posting photos of the school event on social media, we obtained the guardians' consent regarding portrait rights.

notes:
Composed of {肖像|しょうぞう} (portrait, likeness) + {権|けん} (right).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肖像権|しょうぞうけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{侵害|しんがい}→侵害：11563_shingai⟧: infringement of portrait rights
- {肖像権|しょうぞうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{侵|おか}す→侵す：19534_okasu⟧: to violate someone's portrait rights
- {肖像権|しょうぞうけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配慮|はいりょ}する→配慮する：26831_hairyosuru⟧: to take portrait rights into consideration
- {肖像権|しょうぞうけん}⟦フリー→フリー：11001_furii⟧: free of portrait-rights restrictions

USAGE:
Everyday encounters with the word are usually notices — event programs, school newsletters, and photography rules at venues. Public figures are also protected by a commercial aspect of the right, sometimes called {パブリシティ権|ぱぶりしてぃけん}.
